Here's a description of the provided plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for different training configurations. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from 95000 to 125000, with tick labels spaced every 10000 units. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 2.8, with tick labels spaced every 0.2 units. A magenta line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)”, begins at approximately 2.78 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.23 at an iteration of 125000, exhibiting a generally decreasing trend. A blue line, labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, starts at approximately 2.76 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.24 at an iteration of 125000, also showing a generally decreasing trend. An orange line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 2.77 at an iteration of 95000 and decreases to approximately 2.24 at an iteration of 125000, with a similar decreasing trend. Finally, a red dashed line, labeled “Vanilla before post-training”, starts at approximately 2.53 at an iteration of 95000 and remains relatively constant at approximately 2.52 at an iteration of 125000.
